text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: runtime-usw2 — p95 token latency spike (+ error rate 3%) observed for /v1/generate across multiple slices. Spike started ~1738204500. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/reports/17382
sara: I'm oncall, investigating now. Pulling recent deploys and canary traffic.
kevin: seeing sudden rise in kernel-fallbacks on gpu-strong-4 hosts, KV-cache miss rate up ~4x. Batching window collapsed to 8ms on a few nodes.
mira: which release pushed? I see deploy r-2026-03-17-slice-3 rolled 12m ago to 10% canary.
kevin: that matches. Stacktrace shows throttling in prefetch worker and a lot of eviction churn:
```
E 03:41:22 prefetch.cpp:evict() evicting 128 entries, miss_ratio=0.78
W 03:41:23 batcher.cpp:close_window() window_ms=8
```
sara: I'm going to toggle the dispatch feature_flag 'slice_prefetch_v2' to off for all canaries. Doing it in 3...2...1.
deploy-bot: feature flag 'slice_prefetch_v2' set to OFF for env:canary by sara (runbook step 2). :white_check_mark:
kevin: traffic shifted back to stable routing, p95 dropping from ~1.8s -> 300ms within two minutes. Kernel fallback count decreasing.
cs-rep: CS update — AcmePay reported 504s on embeddings calls, HealthWave reported timeouts; both contacted at 03:47. They've been informed mitigation in progress.
product-ops: noted. Please capture affected release and customer impact for postmortem. Tagging release r-2026-03-17-slice-3 and customers: AcmePay, HealthWave.
oncall-sre: current metrics: p50=120ms, p95=310ms, error-rate=0.8%. KernelFallback rate still ~1.2x baseline on 4 hosts. Keeping mitigation engaged.
sara: will keep flag off and monitor for 30m. If stable we'll coordinate a safe re-roll with reduced concurrency and extra kv cache sizing.
paul: (incoming oncall) I can monitor overnight. If p95 climbs >500ms for 10m, I'll trigger temporary burst capacity and re-open the flag if needed.
kevin: root cause hypothesis: new prefetch dispatch heuristic increases KV churn under certain request mixes causing batching fragmentation and kernel fallback. Needs patch to avoid aggressive eviction.
mira: agreed — I'll open a PR to revert the dispatch heuristic and add telemetry to detect churn earlier.
product-ops: create INC-1738 with timeline and customer impact, assign owners: sara (mitigation), kevin (root cause), mira (fix/PR), paul (overnight monitor).
sara: thanks all. I'll update CS with ETA and add runbook checklist. :thumbsup:
paul: acknowledging handoff. Monitoring dashboards now. 1738204920
